import novamind_api as nm

print("=== WEEK 23 ACTIONS (day", nm.vars.current_day, ") ===")

# 1) OPS CUT TEST: $46k -> $25k/day (both >> $500 outage floor, so only affects resolution speed).
#    Keep global dev $1,500. Watch backlog/social/churn next week.
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=25000, development=1500)
print("set_daily_spend: ops=25000 (was 46000), global dev=1500")

# 2) DEV: hold S2 $12k (final wave conv + buffer), ADD D_S07 $6k head-start (grp bonus persists).
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 12000, "D_S07": 6000})
print("set_targeted_dev_spend: S2=12000, D_S07=6000")

# 3) research_group to upgrade info on the two candidate individual engines
for gid in ["D_S07","D_S10"]:
    try:
        r = nm.market.research_group(group_id=gid)
        print(f"research_group({gid}): {r}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"research_group({gid}) ERROR: {e}")

# (Ad spend unchanged: content_marketing S2=$80k, S1=$12k — persists, not re-asserting.)
# (Prices/tiers/quotas/cap T6/lead promo $11/ads_strength 0 unchanged.)

print("\n--- CASH NOW (after one-time research costs) ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) as c FROM ledger")
print("cash:", r['rows'][0]['c'])
print("\n--- this week's one-time research ledger entries ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) as amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day>=161 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['category']}: {row['amt']:.0f} (n={row['n']})")

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== SOCIAL last 7d (sentiment inferred from content) ===")
res = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=80)
posts = res['posts'] if isinstance(res, dict) else res
print("total posts:", res.get('total') if isinstance(res,dict) else len(posts))
import collections
byg = collections.Counter()
neg_kw = ['outage','down','slow','latency','broke','cancel','bug','error','quota','limit','overcharg','disappoint','frustrat','worse','bad','terrible','leav','switch','refund']
pos_kw = ['love','great','amazing','best','excellent','fast','happy','recommend','worth','impress','awesome','fantastic','smooth','reliable']
negc=posc=neuc=0
neg_examples=[]
for p in posts:
    g = p.get('group_id') or '?'
    byg[g]+=1
    c = (p.get('content') or '').lower()
    isneg = any(k in c for k in neg_kw)
    ispos = any(k in c for k in pos_kw)
    if isneg and not ispos:
        negc+=1
        if len(neg_examples)<10: neg_examples.append((g, p.get('persona_name') or '?', p.get('content')))
    elif ispos and not isneg: posc+=1
    else: neuc+=1
print("by group:", dict(byg))
print(f"POS={posc} NEG={negc} NEU={neuc}")
print("--- neg examples ---")
for g,n,c in neg_examples: print(f"  [{g}] {c[:120]}")

print("\n=== ISSUES by group (open vs resolved) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.resolved_day IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as open_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.resolved_day IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as resolved_n
  FROM issues i JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id=c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.group_id""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['group_id']}: open={row['open_n']} resolved={row['resolved_n']}")

print("\n=== OPEN issue age distribution ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN (161-open_day)<=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fresh01,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (161-open_day) BETWEEN 2 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mid,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (161-open_day)>=10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stuck10
  FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL""")
print("  ", r['rows'][0])

print("\n=== USAGE peak/capacity last 7d ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT day, total_usage_units, capacity_units, p95_ms, error_rate, downtime_minutes 
  FROM service_day WHERE day>=155 ORDER BY day""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  day {row['day']}: usage={row['total_usage_units']:,}/{row['capacity_units']:,} ({100*row['total_usage_units']/row['capacity_units']:.0f}%) p95={row['p95_ms']} err={row['error_rate']:.3f} down={row['downtime_minutes']}")

import novamind_api as nm
for gid in ["D_S07","D_S10","D_E08"]:
    ins = nm.market.get_group_insights(group_id=gid)
    est = ins.get('estimates', {})
    print(f"=== {gid} ({ins.get('group_name')}) seg={ins.get('segment')} info_lvl={ins.get('info_level')} {ins.get('noise')} ===")
    print(f"  WTP=${est.get('willingness_to_pay')}  usage={est.get('usage_volume')}/day  q_floor={est.get('quality_floor_q_min')}")
    print(f"  market_cap={est.get('market_cap')}  cap_growth={est.get('annual_market_cap_growth_rate')}  lockin_aversion={est.get('contract_lockin_aversion')}")
    ni = ins.get('network_influence', {})
    print(f"  network out: {ni.get('outgoing')}")
    print(f"  network in:  {ni.get('incoming')}")
print("\n--- compare to S2: WTP=178.6 usage=231 q_floor=0.37 cap=167374 ---")

import novamind_api as nm
r = nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) as c FROM ledger")
print("CASH:", r['rows'][0]['c'])
print("\n--- ALL market_research/research ledger entries (last 3 days) ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT day, category, amount FROM ledger WHERE category LIKE '%research%' AND day>=159 ORDER BY day, amount")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  day{row['day']} {row['category']}: {row['amount']:.0f}")
print("\n--- categories day 161 (recount) ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day=161 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
tot=0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['category']}: {row['amt']:.0f} (n={row['n']})"); tot+=row['amt']
print(f"  day161 NET: {tot:.0f}")
